verses.text: I ask, “Who is this who is coming from Bozrah city in Edom,
I ask him, “What are those red spots on your clothes?
He replies, “I have been treading on my enemies, not on grapes.
I did that because it was time for me [SYN] to get revenge;
I searched for someone who would enable me to help my people,
Because I was extremely angry, I punished the nations;
I will tell about Yahweh faithfully loving his people,
Then we thought about what happened long ago,
Where is the one who showed his glorious power [MTY],
Where is the one who led our ancestors while they walked through the sea bed?
They were like [SIM] cattle that walk down into a valley to rest,
Yahweh, why did you cause us to wander away from your road [RHQ]?
We, your holy people, possessed your sacred temple for only a short time,
Now it seems as though we never were ruled by you,
